# Scrively

> A curated resource for fountain pen enthusiasts, leather accessories, and stationery reviews with video content and photography.

Scrively is a Stockholm-based blog founded by Michael dedicated to reviewing writing instruments, leather goods, and stationery products. The site features in-depth video reviews of luxury fountain pens from brands like Pelikan, OMAS, Pilot, and Lamy, alongside accessory reviews and free stationery wallpapers.

## Key Topics

- Fountain pens
- Pelikan
- Lamy
- Video reviews
- Product reviews
- Luxury pens
- Leather accessories
- Stationery
- Pen nibs
- Everyday carry
- Ateliers Phileas
- TWSBI
- OMAS
- Kaweco
- Pilot

## Fountain Pen Reviews

- [Video-Review: Pelikan M200 Orange Delight](https://scrively.org/video-review-pelikan-m200-orange-delight): Video review of Pelikan M200 Orange Delight fountain pen with piston filler
- [Video-Review: Pilot Custom 823 (Amber)](https://scrively.org/video-review-pilot-custom-823-amber): Video review of Pilot Custom 823 Amber luxury fountain pen with 14k gold nib
- [Video-Review: OMAS Bologna Galassia](https://scrively.org/video-review-omas-bologna-galassia): Video review of OMAS Bologna Galassia luxury fountain pen with piston filling system
- [Video-Review: TWSBI GO](https://scrively.org/video-review-twsbi-go): Video review of TWSBI GO entry-level fountain pen with transparent demonstrator design
- [Video-Review: Kaweco Original (060 & 250)](https://scrively.org/video-review-kaweco-original-060-250): Video review of Kaweco Original octagonal fountain pens with aluminium construction
- [Comparative Overview: Pelikan M815 Metal Stripe Blue & Black](https://scrively.org/comparative-overview-pelikan-m815-metal-stripe-blue-black): Comparative review of Pelikan M815 Metal Stripe fountain pens in blue and black
